description: In every PA-model, the next history is the preceding history with the new step output appended.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.history_successor_value.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA] {n : ℕ}
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.Program (n + 2)) (x : Fin n → M) (k : M) :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.history h).value
      (Fin.snoc x (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M k)) =
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.listAppend.value
      ![(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.history h).value (Fin.snoc x k),
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.listCons.value
          ![h.value
              (Fin.snoc (Fin.snoc x k)
                ((Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.ProofPrograms.history h).value (Fin.snoc x k))),
            Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M]]
